title: tc-score-survey
description: The NPS or CSAT question a person answers, with an optional follow-up and a thank-you.

kind.description: "nps" for 0–10 likelihood to recommend, "csat" for 1–5 satisfaction

question.description: The question; defaults to the standard wording for the kind

score.description: The answer. Changed by the user unless a tc-score-change listener calls preventDefault()

followUp.description: The follow-up question asked after a pick; "" asks none

followUps.description: Follow-up questions by NPS band or CSAT score, ahead of `followUp`

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over `defaultScoreSurveyLabels`

hideBands.description: Hides the NPS band names under the scale

dismissible.description: Shows a dismiss button in the header, which fires tc-dismiss

submitted.description: The answer was submitted: the thank-you shows. Set by Submit and Skip; the app may set it too

submitting.description: Shows Submit as busy while the app saves the answer
